{"access":"read_only","command":"'/Users/jiangtao/Desktop/open-harness/apps/desktop/resources/workspace-runtime/node/bin/node' -e 'const fs=require(\"node:fs\"); const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"outputs/continuity.json\",\"utf8\")); if (!Array.isArray(x.refund_ids) || x.refund_ids.join(\",\") !== \"R301,R302,R303\" || x.applied_refund !== 60 || x.net_received !== 415 || x.unpaid_before_refunds !== 225 || !Array.isArray(x.evidence) || !x.evidence.some(s=>s.includes(\"CORRECTION-ORCHID\") && s.includes(\"event-4\") && s.includes(\"R303 已经人工核实为 settled\"))) process.exit(1); console.log(\"JSON parse and reconciliation/evidence assertions passed\");'","yield_time_ms":10000}
